headline: Executive order on how federal agencies discipline and remove employees, citing merit system principles.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with the rules federal agencies use to hold workers accountable and to remove them from their jobs. It aims to make those removal steps simpler or faster. It says these changes should stay consistent with the merit system principles that govern federal hiring and firing. No summary was provided, so the specific rules it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The rules for disciplining or removing them from their jobs may change.

who_it_affects.group: Supervisors and managers at federal agencies
who_it_affects.how: They may have new or simpler procedures to follow when holding employees accountable or removing them.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 25, 2018; the exact start dates for its provisions are not stated in the available material.
